name: agentarmy-knowledge-ontology
description: Knowledge & ontology engineering agents on a formality gradient: foundational ontologists (UFO/OntoUML and BFO 2020/CCO, coordinating on a dual upper-ontology projection), a foundation-agnostic OWL/SHACL generalist and cluster router, a knowledge engineer for KR&R / knowledge-graph construction and reasoning, and a taxonomist for SKOS/controlled vocabularies. Backs the ontology-derived generative pipeline.
